Record Class TuileHabitat

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
cascadia.items.TuileHabitat
Record Components:
typeHabitat - the habitat type of the tile (e.g., FOREST, RIVER).
habitatPos - the position of the tile on the player's map.
tokenFaune - an optional fauna token placed on this habitat tile.
firstTypeAccepted - the first type of fauna token accepted by this tile.
secondTypeAccepted - the second type of fauna token accepted by this tile.
public record TuileHabitat(TypeHabitat typeHabitat, Position habitatPos, Optional<JetonFaune> tokenFaune, TypeJetonFaune firstTypeAccepted, TypeJetonFaune secondTypeAccepted) extends Record
Represents a habitat tile in the Cascadia game. Each tile has a habitat type, a position, and may contain an optional fauna token.

    • addToken

      public TuileHabitat addToken(JetonFaune token)
      Adds a fauna token to this tile if it is currently free. Returns a new instance of TuileHabitat with the fauna token added. If the tile is already occupied, returns null.
      Parameters:
      token - the fauna token to add to this tile.
      Returns:
      a new TuileHabitat with the fauna token added, or null if the tile is occupied.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the specified fauna token is null.

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a string representation of the habitat tile, showing its type and whether it is occupied by a fauna token. If the tile is free, "EMPTY" is displayed instead of a token.
